text:
The change specification has been written and verified with `plan-lint`:

- `header.json`: Defines repo conventions, architectural decision (`RouteResolutionApiProxy.subscribe` notification paired with `useRouteRef` subscription and version-keyed memo invalidation), single-file checks (`lint`, `prettier`, and the targeted Jest `red_checks`), and the full `project_checks` verification command.
- `units-001.json`:
  - `U01` (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`): Reproducing integration test for `prepareSpecializedApp` with an `app/root.elements` component calling `useRouteRef` for a page route behind `app/root.children`, transitioning from bootstrap to finalized inside a single React root and asserting bounded render count.
  - `U02` (`packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.test.tsx`): Reproducing unit test for `useRouteRef` re-resolving when `routeResolutionApi` notifies subscribers.
  - `U03` (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx`): Adds `subscribe` listener registration and notification on `RouteResolutionApiProxy.initialize`.
  - `U04` (`packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx`): Subscribes `useRouteRef` to `routeResolutionApi.subscribe?.(...)` and invalidates its memoized `resolve` result when notified.
  - `U05` (`docs/frontend-system/architecture/10-app.md`): Documents `useRouteRef` behavior in `app/root.elements` across bootstrap and finalization.
  - `U06` (`.changeset/fix-root-element-route-ref.md`): Adds a `patch` changeset for `@backstage/frontend-app-api` and `@backstage/frontend-plugin-api`.
